Density Quirk.name: Density Quirk
Density Quirk.description:
🪨 You change how dense your body is: heavy, with the density of steel, or light, about the weight of a stack of paper, never both at once.

🌱 Turn heavy in an instant so nothing can shove you, and put your full weight behind a blow.
📈 Training adds drifting down from rooftops, pinning a target, walking a flooded street's bottom, anchoring a sliding car, dropping from the sky and facing a runaway truck.
⚠️ Heavy, you are slow and sink through weak floors; light, a gust carries you off and your blows have no weight. Clothes and gear keep their own weight.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Bodily Toll, as heavy shifts grind your joints and light ones leave you dizzy.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: none close.

📈 Grants: Power +1, Quirk Control +10, Quirk Stamina +10, Grappling +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Leaden Brace, Dropweight Strike
Density Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects: Scale: body density shifts in about a second, size and shape kept: at first heavy to about five times their weight (a large motorbike) or light to about a fifth (leaps to a second-floor window, falls several stories unhurt), for about a minute. Car weight, drifting, gliding: learned techniques. Limits: heavy or light, never both or uneven; clothes, gear and anyone carried keep their weight. Heavy: walking pace, no jumps or swims, sinks, breaks wood floors, car roofs; shoves, tackles, blasts and wind cannot budge them; blades, bullets, heat and electricity still hurt. Light: gusts carry them off, blows lack weight, solid hits fling them. Quirk Strain: light: brace, weighted blow; moderate: slow descent, pin, underwater walk; heavy: counterweight, sky drop; severe: signature blow, truck weight. Type: Transformation. Law: unlicensed pinning under their weight is assault; floors or roofs they break are their property damage. Look: heavy, gray veins; light, pale skin.
